title: The 4 Best Dehumidifiers Under $150
metaDescription: Our 4 picks for dehumidifiers under $150, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at dehumidifiers under $150 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Vremi 50-Pint Dehumidifier for 4,500 Sq Ft Spaces
products.blurb: Key specs: 50-pint-per-day rating for spaces up to 4,500 sq ft, 1.8-gallon tank with full-tank auto shut-off, Continuous drain hose option.
strengths: Frequently the lowest street price of any 50-pint Energy Star unit in this category
Continuous drain hose option removes manual bucket-emptying without needing a pump
Caster wheels make it easy to move between rooms as needed
limitations: No built-in pump, so continuous drainage requires a downhill gravity run
Runs louder than pricier models at comparable fan settings
Housing feels less substantial than the Frigidaire
features: 50-pint-per-day rating for spaces up to 4,500 sq ft

products.name: Midea Cube 35-Pint Smart Dehumidifier with Pump
products.blurb: Key specs: 35-pint-per-day rating, covers up to 3,500 sq ft, Built-in pump with included drain hose, Wi-Fi control via the MideaAir app.
strengths: Built-in pump and app control at a price point that usually skips both
Quietest compressor of the models in this roundup
limitations: 35-pint capacity is lower than the Vremi's 50-pint rating
Learning the Cube's lift-and-twist tank takes a try or two
features: 35-pint-per-day rating, covers up to 3,500 sq ft
Built-in pump with included drain hose
Wi-Fi control via the MideaAir app

products.name: Frigidaire FFAD3534W1 35-Pint Dehumidifier
strengths: Auto shutoff when the bucket is full
limitations: Bucket must be emptied without a hose
Not sized for very wet basements

products.name: hOmeLabs 4,500 Sq Ft Energy Star Dehumidifier
limitations: Tank capacity is modest without a hose
Listing capacity figures vary by test standard

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
